prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–outbound release; accuracy/dispatch/safety/inventory compliance. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass) owns inventory/locations/eligibility/shipments/tasks/priorities; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment; receives Oversize Load Advisory/Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; timestamps transactions/reconciles movements/shift-plan. Allocation requires availability/access/count/inspection/door-release/dimensional/mass/handling/clearance suitability; mismatches inhibit automation; holds retain reason/scan/time/location pending validated disposition. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook) validates arrivals/blocks risks; receives Trailer Seal Exception Note from Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay), which checks identifiers/seals/paperwork/counts, receives advisory, segregates damage, records proceed/rework/hold. Inbound Pallet Buffer staging≠acceptance. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) produces dimensions/Oversize Load Advisory; checks configured tolerances; exceptions held; no placement authority. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane execute zoned moves; cross-aisle controlled. North receives reservation/checks task/destination/access/clearance, sends occupancy; stale reports block induction; obstructions stop movement. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor route separately. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven) checks identification/inspection/sensors/readiness; single-pallet merges; produces/validates Transfer Induction Ticket; preserves recovery order. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur) receives ticket/checks route-destination/vehicle/safety/access, confirms pickup, produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield) records inspection/authorizer/repairs, produces Crane Service Release Card; status checked before automatic return. Crane faults require isolation; failed tests retain inhibition; release requires interlock/limit checks. Fire Alarm Panel produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice; Safety Zone Controller maintains exclusions until release; both retain stop authority. Outbound Dispatch Sorter follows authorized amendments/plan. Outbound Checkweigh Scale produces Gross Weight Variance Slip; resolve reweigh/documented-safe-disposition; reference-check shift-start/postmaintenance. Shipping Documentation Desk uses confirmed pallet/destination. Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews alarms/status/unresolved-work, confirms speed/exclusion/stop-work understanding, verifies personnel-clear recovery. Recovery requires reconciliation, travel-envelope/stopping-point/stop-conditions, minimum reduced-speed South movements, staged/observed resumption. East restart:

New part:
S217: At handover, the outgoing shift records equipment restrictions, pending checks, and unresolved safety concerns.
S218: The incoming shift acknowledges those conditions before authorizing routine movements.
S219: Commissioning acceptance is conducted against an approved test plan before routine warehouse operation begins.
S220: The test plan defines expected behavior, safety limits, evidence requirements, and criteria for blocking release.
S221: Each subsystem is exercised under representative loads, including recovery from interrupted transactions and controlled equipment stops.
S222: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor confirms that acceptance evidence is complete and that any remaining limitations are documented.
S223: The Warehouse Management System is checked for inventory accuracy, transaction integrity, and correct handling of unavailable storage locations.
S224: Acceptance is withheld when a material defect could compromise personnel safety, inventory control, or shipment accuracy.
S225: The Warehouse Management System uses the handoff confirmation to close the applicable movement record.
S226: The Shipping Documentation Desk receives and reconciles the Gross Weight Variance Slip against the applicable shipment record before completing its paperwork.
S227: A scale variance outside the approved tolerance is investigated and resolved before the affected shipment is released.
S228: The North Aisle Stacker Crane accepts the release card as authorization to return to service after its checks are complete.
S229: A crane remains unavailable for automated assignments until its functional checks and required safety checks have passed.
S230: Morrowglass closes the commissioning action register only after unresolved findings have named owners and due dates.
S231: Cinderbay records governance approval and confirms that the accepted operating configuration is under change control.
S232: Brasshaven verifies that conveyor zones are clear and records the completion of its assigned closing checks.
S233: Larkspur parks its vehicles in approved locations and reports any remaining equipment restrictions for the next shift.
S234: Copperfield records completed service work and confirms that equipment restrictions remain visible until formally cleared.
S235: The Fire Alarm Panel is checked for active faults, bypasses, and indications requiring escalation before the facility is released.
S236: The Safety Zone Controller is verified against the approved access boundaries and stop-response behavior.
S237: The Inbound Inspection Desk and Outbound Dispatch Sorter confirm that their operating interfaces are available and that exceptions can be held safely.
S238: Changes to software, equipment settings, or operating procedures require an impact review, approval, and a controlled implementation record.
S239: Emergency changes are documented promptly and reviewed by the Warehouse Operations Supervisor before normal operation resumes.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
